register.description:
GPADC TX 1 CONTROL
TX set 1 control register

bitfield.description:
SENSOR INDEX
0 - ATB 1 - Vdd_Main 2 - Vdd_PA 3 - Thermal Protection 4 - Thermal Calibration 5 - Env_Det_Calibration 6 - BG Blocker 7 - PM BIST 8 - RFCIO TEST_M 9 - RFCIO TEST_P (using thermal protectio sens sel only) 10 - PM BG 0.9V 11 - PM BG 1.22V 12 - I2V_VOUT 13 - SPARE2 14 - IS_RX_FILTER

DELAY FROM EVENT
Full span 0..31 *1.6us, jumps in 1.6us, up to ~49.6us Full span 0..31 *1.7us, jumps in 1.7us, up to ~52.7us Full span 0..31 *2us, jumps in 2us, up to ~62us Full span 0..31 *2.4us, jumps in 2.4us, up to ~74.4us
*note - 1 ganulation cycle (1.6/1.7/2.0/2.4 us) need to be kept between 2 Agents
0 - 0.5us - minimum value. 1 - 1.6us 2 - 3.2us 3 - 4.8us ... 31 - 49.6us *note- delay from event is not accurate, additional of up to 200ns might be added.

NUMBER OF SAMPLES
Full span 0..31 *1.6us, jumps in 1.6us, up to ~49.6us Full span 0..31 *1.7us, jumps in 1.7us, up to ~52.7us Full span 0..31 *2us, jumps in 2us, up to ~62us Full span 0..31 *2.4us, jumps in 2.4us, up to ~74.4us
*note - 1 ganulation cycle need to be kept between 2 Agents
0 - not allowed 1 - 1.6us 2 - 3.2us 3 - 4.8us ... 31 - 49.6us

DELAY INTERVAL
Full span 0..63 *12.8us, jumps in 12.8us, up to ~793.6us Full span 0..63 *13.6us, jumps in 13.6us, up to ~843.2us Full span 0..63 *16us, jumps in 16us, up to ~992us Full span 0..63 *19.2us, jumps in 19.2us, up to ~1190.4us
*note - 1 ganulation cycle need to be kept between 2 Agents
0 - Continues Mode (with gaps of 1 GPADC clk cycle between each number of samples) 1 - 12.8 us 2 - 25.6us 3 - 38.4us ... 62 - 793.6us 63 - Single shot [one sample]

BYPASS ALPHA FILTER
Alpha filter block indication, bypass the alpha filter for the first sample

HARDWARE THRESHOLD ENABLE
enble the comparators block to compare sample to HW threshold

GAIN OUT SELECT
'00' - chooses del_vbe_buf_outm '01' - chooses del_vbe_buf_outp '10' - chooses diffrential both p and m '11' - NA
PMCIO spare dynamic bits
RFCIO spare dynamic bits

register.description: GPADC general control

bitfield.description:
MUTE DISABLE
'1' - disables the line mute output
adc end of conversion (busy) indication

NONE EVENT MODE
'1' - for using only RX set 1. ignors the TX transition. '0' - regular operation
Process to operate NON EVENT MODE:
1. Disable ALL SETs. 2. config RX SETs 3. Enable NON EVENT MODE 4. Enable RX SETs 5. once measurement has finished, Disable all SETs and reconfigure 6. Disable NON EVENT MODE 7. Enable SETs

SELECT OVERRIDE START OF CONVERSION
'1' - uses overide value '0' - use regular operation

OVERRIDE START OF CONVERSION
'1' - uses overide value '0' - use regular operation

SELCT OVERRIDE CLEAR
'1' - uses overide value '0' - use regular operation

OVERRIDE CLEAR
overide value

SELECT OVERRIDE ADC EN
'1' - uses overide value '0' - use regular operation

OVERRIDE ADC ENABLE
overide value

SELCT OVERRIDE PMCIO TEMP SENSOR
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

OVERRIDE PMCIO TEMP SENSOR
overide value

SELECT OVERRIDE REGISTER 0
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE REGISTER 1
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE POWER DETECT BUFFER REGISTER 0
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE POWER DETECT BUFFER REGISTER 1
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE RXIF
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE RXFEB REG4
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

SELECT OVERRIDE TEMPRATURE SENSOR WLAN
'0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

OUTPUT REGISTER USAGE
LX PG1 and PG2 use only, for boot measurements. after boot should be set '1'. GPADC_REG0 and GPADC_REG1 control only. '0' - No GPADC CTRL '1' - GPADC CTRL output regs usage

register.description: SETS GENERAL CONTROL

bitfield.description:
INJECT MODE
when '1' user config the mode : Manual (0) vs. Auto (1). Default is manual

MANUAL SET SELECTOR
during debug a user would like to set the set selector 00 - RX A 01 - RX B 10 - TX A 11 - TX B

GRANULATION SELECT
defines the GPADC granulation 0 - 1.6us 1 - 1.7us 2 - 2us 3 - 2.4us

INJECT ENABLE
when '1' use Inject mode '1' - use manual set selector

SINGLE MODE
Force clear @adc_soc for each sample (1.6us); Defaul is 0 (Continous mode).

register.description:
LOG ALPHA
GPADC Log Alpha cntrol reister Alpha value = 2^(-mem_) for example if mem_= 1 then alpha is 0.5.
Y(n)= (1-alpha)*Y(n-1)+(alpha)*X(n)=Y(n-1)+(alpha)*(X(n)-Y(n-1))
